verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a dedicated Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) feature that lets developers use their own provider API keys with the Requesty gateway, which is the core of this story. The evidence is a single sentence from the feature page, so the details are not shown. Missing for 10: which providers are supported, how keys are stored and secured, whether traffic falls back to Requesty-managed keys, how BYOK traffic is billed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own provider API keys and have the gateway use them for my traffic

citations.quote: Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) allows you to use your personal API keys from various providers with Requesty.
